Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL3039007. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3039007'. Return rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
